typography.notes: Ensure clean, iOS-like readability. German language has longer compound words, so ensure text truncation or wrapping is handled gracefully in list views (e.g. using line-clamp).

colors.theme: Dark mode by default, support for light mode via toggle. High contrast iOS style.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/70 (or bg-white/70 for light mode) for sticky headers and the floating bottom tab bar. Never use pure transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Use rounded-2xl for main grouped list cards, rounded-xl for inner elements or smaller cards. Pill shapes (rounded-full) for primary CTAs like 'Zur Bibliothek hinzufügen'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows in dark mode (rely on 1px borders and distinct surface colors for separation). In light mode, use shadow-sm for cards.

component_guidelines.grouped_lists: Classic iOS Settings style. Container with bg-[#1c1c1e] and rounded-2xl. Items separated by border-b border-[#38383a]. Left side: icon inside a rounded-md colored square (e.g., bg-blue-500, bg-indigo-500). Middle: Title. Right side: Count or value (text-secondary) and chevron-right.
component_guidelines.bottom_tab_bar: Floating pill at bottom. rounded-full, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70, border border-white/10. Contains 3 main tabs (Bücher, Entdecken, Statistiken) and a search icon/button.
component_guidelines.bottom_sheet_form: For 'Buch hinzufügen'. Use a dialog/drawer that slides up. Large form with grouped sections (BUCHDETAILS, LESESTATUS, KATEGORIEN). Full-width pill button 'Zur Bibliothek hinzufügen' sticky at the bottom.
component_guidelines.calendar_view: Monthly grid highlighting reading spans. Days with reading sessions show a tiny book cover or highlighted background span. Clean, subtle, non-intrusive.
component_guidelines.book_card: Vertical cover image (rounded-md aspect-[2/3]), title below (1-2 lines truncated text-sm font-semibold), author (text-xs text-secondary), and a small badge 'Teil X' if part of a series.
component_guidelines.badges: Small pill badges for series info or formats. e.g., bg-white/10 text-white text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Design specifically for mobile viewport (w-full max-w-md mx-auto or full width on phone) but allow scaling for tablet/desktop by keeping content centered.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-4 or p-6 for main padding. gap-6 between major sections. Use pb-28 to clear the floating tab bar.
grids_and_layouts.forms: iOS style grouped form fields for 'Buch hinzufügen'. Label on left, input/value on right. Use native-looking inputs or customized shadcn Select/Input.

motion.transitions: Smooth transitions for state changes (opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease). Do not use 'transition: all'.
motion.interactions: Buttons and list items scale down slightly on active: active:scale-[0.98] or active:opacity-70.
motion.sheets: Slide up from bottom for additive actions, slide from right for drill-down navigation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets 4.5:1. Avoid dark text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements (buttons, list rows, tabs).

book_covers.description: Minimalist white book cover, use as placeholder for minimal books.
Fantasy book cover, use for fiction placeholders.

avatars.description: User profile avatar for settings screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the iOS grouped list layouts, as Shadcn cards might be too rigid to look exactly like iOS Settings.
For the floating bottom tab bar, use position: fixed, bottom: 4 or 6, left/right centered, rounded-full, backdrop-blur-xl.
Implement the 'Buch hinzufügen' view as a comprehensive form with grouped sections (BUCHDETAILS, LESESTATUS, BUCHFORMAT, EIGENTUMSSTATUS, KATEGORIEN, SAMMLUNGEN, SERIE, ORTE).
Use Lucide-react for iOS-like simple stroke icons.
Ensure German translations for all UI texts exactly as requested (Bibliothek, Entdecken, Statistiken, Bücher, Sammlungen, Formate, Wunschliste, Zu Lesen, etc.).
Use a pure black (`bg-black` mapping to `#000000`) background for the body in dark mode to match iOS OLED aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
